description: PCRL matched removal benchmark (Round-4 Adult + HMDA encoders): effective executed settings

panel.unit_id_format: <dataset>__s<encoder seed>__<purpose>__<attribute>__<arm>; arm in A, B, C, D_sigma<s:g>_rs<k>
panel.note: encoder seeds, release seeds and attacker seeds are replicates over the same people, never units

roles.description: roles are read from INPUTS_INDEX (role 1); the runner re-derives the HMDA / fallback hash rules and the Adult pilot counts as checks (reported by dry-run)

support.concept_rule: an eraser (B or C) is fitted on the FULL declared one-hot of its concept only if every class of every concept attribute has >= min_defense_fit_concept rows in defense_fit; otherwise that unit is NE (nothing is dropped or pooled silently). Coordinator decision 2026-10-02
support.pair_rule: a pair is supported iff both classes are supported
support.scoring_rule: evaluation support is per role (100/30/100 on attacker_fit/attacker_val/assessment), identical for every arm of a cell, frozen in SUPPORT_FROZEN.json before any fit
support.task_classes: the same 100/30/100 rule selects task classes for macro-F1/AUC; accuracy and log loss use all assessment rows

leace.settings_note: OFFICIAL concept-erasure defaults (coordinator decision 2026-10-02); no distinct svd_tol=0 arm
leace.concept_B: onehot(target attribute), all declared classes (no pooling)
leace.concept_C: defenses.concat_marginal_onehots of the policy set, in disallowed_attrs order
leace.cache_key: (dataset, encoder seed, purpose, concept spec); fitted once, reused by every unit
leace.alias_rule: defenses.alias_test: C aliases B iff max|P_B - P_C| <= alias_atol and max|mean_B - mean_C| <= alias_atol

official.tree_hash_rule: sha256 over sorted *.py (excluding __pycache__): update('concept_erasure/'+relpath) then update(file bytes)

noise.description: one persistent draw per person: default_rng(release seed) over the matrix of scored-role rows (attacker_fit, attacker_val, assessment) in ascending row_id order

A.label: PCRL historical one-hot ridge R2, in-sample on the test split; compared per seed with dominant_axis_audit.json r2_onehot

BC.primary_rule: the official implementation's own specified bound: spectral norm of the whitened residual cross-covariance on defense_fit <= svd_tol; failure -> category C1
BC.descriptive_rule: exact-zero cross-covariance (crosscov_max_abs_rel_erased <= tol_rel and fit-row OLS R2 <= tol_r2); OUTSIDE_TOLERANCE_SVD_TOL_TRUNCATION is reported as a separate descriptive column, NOT C1
BC.out_of_support: per (dataset, seed, purpose): norm of the component of (h - fit mean) outside the range of the defense_fit sample covariance on attacker_fit and assessment rows (label-free); official behaviour = identity there (transfer limitation column)
BC.label: LEACE condition on defense_fit, finite-sample scope only

D.label: no native certificate (unclipped Gaussian noise; Prop 3 covers clipped only)

cross_cov_heldout.description: weighted Frobenius norm and max-abs of cov(released h, concept one-hot) on assessment rows; concept = target one-hot (B scope) and policy concatenated one-hot (C scope)

GBT.description: HistGradientBoostingClassifier; early stopping on an internal split of attacker_fit

plus_slate.ignore_rep: the outputs_only selected model of the same family slot (NL or L)
plus_slate.ignore_out: the C_rep selected model of the same family slot (NL or L)

attackers.retrain: the selected recipe (family + hyper-parameters) is refit at each attacker seed; seed 0 is the grid fit itself (random_state 0); the grid is never rerun
attackers.leace_simulation: alias of the ordinary slate trained on erased attacker-population features (recorded)

surfaces.description: outputs_only is fitted once per (dataset, encoder seed, purpose, attribute) and aliased into every arm; the clean outputs are identical across methods

U1.scope: outside LEACE's scope: the frozen head is Linear-ReLU-Linear (nonlinear post-processing can re-create linearly detectable signal)
U1.description: frozen purpose head on the transformed representation (compatibility only)

U2.description: common LR probe on the transformed representation; shared across attributes when the release is identical

clean_output.description: the clean head's task accuracy and log loss; unchanged across methods

recovery_metrics.LLR_nats: LL0 - LL (nats per row; LL0 = attacker_fit prior)
recovery_metrics.worst_class: max OvR AUC over supported classes
recovery_metrics.worst_pair: max pair AUC over supported pairs, score p_j/(p_i+p_j)

sigma_star.statistic: C_rep NL macro OvR AUC over supported classes
sigma_star.rule: smallest sigma whose attacker_val statistic (mean over encoder seeds x release seeds, attacker seed 0) is <= bar; none -> fallback_sigma, flagged

inference.draw: rng = numpy.random.default_rng(seed); replicate b: counts = rng.multinomial(n_units, full(n_units, 1/n_units)); row weight = counts[unit index]; unit order = numpy.unique(assess_unit); one draw per dataset re-weights every unit, arm, encoder seed, release seed and attacker seed of that dataset

primary.validity_note: percentile bounds are asymptotic; each endpoint can err in one direction, so two one-sided bounds at alpha/24 bound the family-wise error by 0.05 (asymptotically)

inference.replicate_summary: mean over encoder seeds x release seeds x attacker seeds, computed within each bootstrap replicate on the same resampled people
inference.worst_rule: simultaneous per-class/pair bounds at alpha/K (K = supported classes or pairs): LCB(max) = max_k LCB_k(alpha/K), UCB(max) = max_k UCB_k(alpha/K); point = max_k point_k
inference.max_ne_replicate_fraction: the tail probability of the bound; more NE replicates -> NE

budget.stop_rule: before each Tier-2 unit (fixed order): stop if spent + projected(unit) + inference reserve for all completed-or-started units > cpu_hours*3600; never skip ahead
budget.projection: mean measured cpu of completed units of the same dataset and arm kind; calibration estimate until one exists
budget.tier2_trigger: every Tier-1 unit COMPLETE and hash-verified, SIGMA_STAR.json present, A native reproduction, B/C native checks pass, U1 consistency ok, no technical failure

sanity.description: fit/validation-only shuffled-label sanity: s permuted within attacker_fit and within attacker_val; C_rep slate fitted and selected through the same code path; assessment never loaded into the fit

unsupported.R12_repeated_release: persistent contract: N collapses to 1 (A3 staged, not run)
unsupported.R11_adaptive_general: LEACE arms: the ordinary slate on erased features is the defense-aware attack (alias)
unsupported.oracle_leace: never used (needs target labels at inference)
unsupported.permutation_null_real: replaced by the fit/validation-only shuffled-label sanity check
unsupported.round5_7_checkpoints: separate labelled extension; never mixed into Round-4 rows
